acceptance: The migration skips its own manifest and other non-bundle companions (.manifest.json, .override.json and the like), or refuses a manifest path inside --bundles-dir
Running the documented command twice on the same directory succeeds and reports no changes the second time
A test covers the rerun case
context: Found while staging Databricks bundles for publication on 2026-10-04. The workaround was to anonymise each batch in a fresh directory (`~/Developer/benchmark_runs/tools/stage_pr_b_databricks_20261004.py`).
description: `_project/scripts/results_explorer_corpus_migrate.py --bundles-dir <dir> --manifest <dir>/migration-manifest.json --write` treats every `.json` file in the directory as a result bundle. When the directory already holds the migration manifest from an earlier run, a rerun fails in `transformer.result_id_from_bundle` with `ValueError: Unsupported schema version for explorer input schema policy: '1'`. The documented publishing step writes that manifest into the same directory it scans, so the step is not safely repeatable.
